verdict.rationale: Plausible's script captures pageviews automatically, including SPA routing, and the docs say it automatically tracks file downloads, form completions, external link clicks and scroll depth without code. Automatic capture is limited to these specific event types, and other events need custom event setup. Missing for 10: general autocapture of arbitrary clicks, coverage of form interactions beyond completions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the automatic tracking.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can capture clicks, pageviews, and form interactions automatically without writing tracking code for each event

citations.quote: Automatically track file downloads, form completions and external link clicks.
supports SPAs out of the box, including pushState and hash-based routing.
Scroll depth from 1 to 100 percent is tracked automatically on every page. No setup, no tag managers.
One lightweight script, one easy-to-read dashboard.
